notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.407 repairs two startup paths observed in recent logs. A partial serial packet no longer hides the firmware announcement or subsequent valid samples. The real source PDF worker bootstraps its module path, and native PDF workers resolve relative inputs and run from the application directory. Report failures now show useful worker exit and log information.

108 focused regressions and the standard GUI, parser, worker, analyzer, layout and smoke checks passed. Both failed startup captures replay with all 49 previously skipped samples recovered and original bytes unchanged. Compiled release validation additionally requires startup recovery and ordinary/detached reports from a foreign working directory.

Firmware remains rev27v-followup-355. This GUI update does not claim to fix pending SysID execution, refill delivery, inflation coverage or unsettled-hold behavior that requires hardware validation. Calibration, PID, pressure limits and device-lock policy are preserved.
